modes.cue_notes: From Warrior 2, flip the front palm up and reach it toward the sky, sliding the back hand down the back leg while keeping the front knee bent and the hips grounded in the lunge.

breathing_cues.entering: Inhale as the front arm sweeps up and back, opening the side body away from the back leg.
breathing_cues.holding: Each inhale lengthens the reaching arm and side ribs, each exhale keeps the front knee stacked and stable.
breathing_cues.exiting: Inhale to rise back to Warrior 2, sweeping the front arm forward and level.

prop_free_variation: Rest the back hand on the back thigh instead of sliding down the shin to keep weight off the front knee.
